description: Schema fill: mold public data into our own competitor schema. 20 companies x 8 fields. Ground truth for grading lives in S6_truth.json and is never sent to a provider.
instructions: Fill every field from current public sources, preferring the company's own pages (pricing, docs, trust center, security, legal, blog, press releases). Use null for any field you can't verify. Give a source URL for every non-null field. Don't guess: the cited page must support the value. For an absence answer (for example 'none found'), say which pages were checked.

fields.web_search_source: What powers the company's web search or web-data retrieval: 'own index' (it crawls and indexes the web itself), a named third-party provider (for example Google via SERP scraping, Bing, Brave, Exa), or a mix. Name any upstream provider.
fields.soc2: SOC 2 status: 'Type II', 'Type I', 'in progress', or 'none found', with the report or attestation date if stated.
fields.zero_data_retention: Whether zero data retention is offered: 'yes' (and on which plan), 'no', or 'not found'.
fields.hipaa_baa: Whether the company will sign a HIPAA Business Associate Agreement: 'yes' (which plan), 'no', or 'not found'.
fields.official_mcp_server: Whether the company publishes an official MCP server: 'yes' (with its name or URL) or 'no'.
fields.free_tier: The free tier or trial for its API (for example '1,000 credits/month', '$10 free credits', 'none').
fields.list_price: Pay-as-you-go list price of its primary search or retrieval API, in USD per 1,000 requests; name the unit and tier. For seat-priced or quote-only products, say so.
fields.last_funding: Most recent funding round or acquisition: type, amount in USD, date, and lead investor or acquirer.
